primary_design: CALIBRATION_AWARE_CONTEXT_DESIGN_20261106.md is authoritative for the main algorithm, notation, and validation protocol; this attachment covers source interfaces and costs.
proposed_architecture: Frozen 2026 TabICLv2; accumulate source-state-specific, coordinate-wise squared margin-Jacobian differences g_i,d on the full KV cache; use this geometry for prototype assignment and coordinate-wise centers at the same M; apply QCOC's original closed-form value fit; independent final normal calibration; no deployed N-row bank. QCOC plus CRT value-only adaptation is a comparator, not the main algorithm.
unresolved_before_implementation: No verified official QCOC/Localized implementation; formula-level adaptation must not be described as executing author code.
Actual checkpoint tensor inventory and CPU timings not measured.
Full-cache margin-Jacobian accumulation and the value-only training comparator require a differentiable Stage3 path bypassing official inference no_grad wrappers.
Custom mass bias changes attention backend; matched backend and official fastest full-KV references both required.
